title: PropShare
tagline: PropShare: Empowering fractional ownership and transparent rentals through blockchain technology and the Sign Protocol
description: Introducing PropShare, a revolutionary platform redefining real estate ownership and rental experiences through Web3 technology, blockchain transparency, and the Sign Protocol for authenticity and neon for utilizing cheap txns cost. PropShare enables individuals to securely purchase fractional shares of coveted real estate properties, breaking down barriers to ownership and facilitating transparent investment opportunities. Utilizing blockchain technology, every transaction and ownership record is securely stored, ensuring immutable proof of ownership and fostering trust within the community. With the integration of the Sign Protocol, PropShare guarantees the authenticity of ownership and rental agreements, providing users with cryptographic security and peace of mind. Neon EVM will help in scaling the no. of transactions by leveraging its cheap transaction cost. Explore PropShare today to unlock the potential of shared ownership, transparent rental arrangements, and empowered real estate investment in the digital era.
how_its_made:
The platform's architecture is built upon a robust foundation, integrating various technologies to deliver seamless user experiences. At its core, PropShare utilizes React for its frontend, providing a dynamic and intuitive interface for users to interact with.

For the backend infrastructure, PropShare employs a combination of technologies to handle data storage, processing, and business logic. Tableland, a decentralized database solution, ensures data integrity and resilience, while also enabling scalability to accommodate growing user demands.

To efficiently query and analyze data on the blockchain, PropShare leverages The Graph, a powerful indexing protocol. This enables fast and reliable access to on-chain data, facilitating real-time updates and insights for users.

Additionally, the integration of Neon EVM plays a pivotal role in scaling transaction throughput by leveraging its cost-effective transaction model. This ensures that users can seamlessly execute transactions on the platform without incurring high fees, enhancing accessibility and affordability for all participants.
